from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x != 0)
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    minr = min(r for r, c in points)
    minc = min(c for r, c in points)
    offsets = [(r - minr, c - minc) for r, c in points]
    oh = max(r for r, c in offsets) + 1
    ow = max(c for r, c in offsets) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(h - oh + 1):
        for left in range(w - ow + 1):
            cells = [(top + dr, left + dc) for dr, dc in offsets]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
